■ Direction
SE: Whistle

I was suddenly scolded by an Umamusume I didn't even know.
However...

...I am Believe.
Um, can I help you?

That's an option, but...
Feint a pass here and—

I tried to chase after them in a rush, but the road was a dead straight line.
There was no way I could catch up to a motorcycle on this.

Calstone Light O—turned into an arrow faster than the wind.
Exceeding the top speed any Umamusume could reach, and—

Hey, hey, Light O, can I get your advice on something...?
Actually, I got into a huge fight with a friend.

...Yes!
Pass... Here you go, Light O-san!

Normally, one wouldn't make it in time.
However, if we take a "straight line" from here to the classroom.

I will catch that purse-snatcher and make them atone.
Without fail!

I must make it in time! Here I go!
HYAAAAAAAHHH!!

And I'm supposed to be guiding Umamusume...
This won't do.

I saw—a light.
A single streak of light.

There is a reason I was late for school.
As for what happened...

I feel bad about it too. But it's hard to apologize, 
so I want to make up step-by-step, basically.

I thought she was a cool, collected Umamusume... but I was wrong.
What is up with this girl?

Calstone Light O may look sleek and sharp on the outside,
but she seemed to be quite an intriguing, peculiar Umamusume.

I witnessed something unbelievable.
That Umamusume—

Umamusume are overwhelmingly fast compared to normal humans. But against a
motorcycle, it's a completely different story. Once they pull that far ahead, catching up should be...

She seems to bluntly blurt out whatever is on her mind...
From things that are hard to say, to things you definitely shouldn't say.

Yes. We will assume curves do not exist.
If we run the shortest possible distance in a near-straight line—

Ah... Charging straight into the defense...!
Oh dear...

What!? Never mind that, we must hurry.
There is still a method to avoid being late.

Whether it's basketball or soccer, she just dribbles in a straight line.
And then her moves get read, and she gets shut down...
Understood. I just need to convey that implicitly.

At this point, my only option is tape!
If nobody notices, it won't be embarrassing!
Just as I thought there was no hope—

Sure enough, she slammed hard into the Three Goddesses statue.
She went tumbling across the courtyard.

Calstone Light O charged right into the center of the enemy lines without hesitation,
and was instantly stripped of the ball.
D-Don't say every single thing out loud~!

—I overslept!
And I call myself a Trainer...

The running speed of an Umamusume far surpasses that of an ordinary human.
However, given the time left until the chime rings, there was no way...

Her acceleration is smooth. Truly an Umamusume.
But the real problem starts here.

Forgive me, but I am actually running late as well.
To be precise, right on the verge of it.
Take that!! Yoink!!

Unbelievably, a motorcycle approaching from behind snatched my bag!
To think I'd get purse-snatched...
Huh... Are you a Trainer from somewhere?

From here—on outtt!
Oooohhhhhh—!!

There's no way she could output a top speed that exceeds a motorcycle.
She'll hit her limit eventually and get pulled away from...
(RIIIIIIING!)

Before I could stop her and say, "Are you insane!?", the Umamusume bolted.
And then—
HYAAAAAAAHHH!

Breakthrough dribble!
TAAAAAAAHHHHHH!

Are you alright!?
Leave this to me—!

Double our score, huh...
What a devastating loss...
GYAAAAAAAH! Ow ow ow!

Hmph, basketball today, is it?
Run towards the hoop, Believe!

We need to talk. She wants to make up with you.
Though she mentioned it's hard for her to say she was wrong.

That Umamusume—unleashed a top speed surpassing that motorcycle,
and stood right in the thief's path.
Therefore, I am currently securing my skirt with tape.

How could this happen...?! To think that while changing,
my skirt's zipper would refuse to zip up...!
Whaaaat, no waaayyyy!?

Believe seemed to be a sprint Umamusume of the deliberate, prudent type.
When I asked her more about Calstone Light O—

You're... a Trainer, aren't you?
Are you late?

Yes...
Light O-san is always straightforward and utterly uncompromising.

I'm almost certainly not going to make it on time.
Even so, as I ran frantically up to the school gate...

Word of that excessively straightforward Umamusume, "Calstone Light O,"
reached my ears in many different ways.
—And then, on the way home one day.
